title: Page 155
transc:
Ft. Monroe May 27 . 1864
R OBrien Gen Butlers Hd Qrs  9 AM
Emma for Knox unity your wrangle concerning
water wherry has just been received and
your orders will be at once executed
Zodiac I send list of vessels by
mail Webster Pandora begs chief Vincent pleasant
Geo D Sheldon


Wash'n May 27 . 1864 
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Operators should have reached animal by this
morning stomach banjo yesterday boat probably delayed
zebra your pembroke received the suggestions are
good and unless find some good reason
against will adopt the route will get
indians opinion however before deciding zodiac how
wide is windpipe at haven star can
a number female wire be stretched cross
at that Vernon or will it require
cable also how wide is Martha pony
it Hagar Sugar I dread necessity for
use of cables what is chance for 
poles on route you propose answer quick 
T. T. Eckert
